newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mazda sees higher 1997 domestic output.
newsitem.headline: Mazda sees higher 1997 domestic output.

text.p: Mazda Motor Corp said on Thursday that it expects its vehicle production in Japan to rise 0.2 percent from a year earlier to 775,000 vehicles in calendar 1997, after a projected 0.2 percent gain in 1996.
Mazda, owned 33.4 percent by Ford Motor Co, expects its vehicle sales in Japan to rise 7.8 percent to 365,000 vehicles in 1997, after a projected 8.2 percent fall in 1996.
The company said also that it expects its vehicle exports from Japan to rise 1.4 percent in 1997 to 460,000 units, after a projected 3.0 percent rise in 1996.
It predicted overseas production would fall 6.9 percent to 150,000 next year, after a projected 4.2 percent fall in 1996.
